rec.name: PDP Image Gallery – Infinite Swipe Loop & Configurable Dots
rec.status: Backlog – ideas for v1.1 of the product image gallery

what.text: An enhancement to the product image slider (mobile swipe gallery). (1) Infinite swipe: after the last product photo, the user can keep swiping left and the gallery loops back to the first photo. (2) Pagination dots with a configurable shape (circles or squares) and three definable color states: Active / filled, Inactive / filled, Inactive / outlined only.

why.text: A looping gallery has no dead end, so browsing product images feels continuous and the user is never stopped at the last image. This encourages more image views, and more image engagement usually means more confidence in the product. Dots that match the brand's design language and clearly show the active state improve orientation (where am I, how many images are there). This is mainly a UX polish, so the expected conversion effect is small.

how.text: Enable loop mode in the slider library the theme gallery uses (e.g. a 'loop' or 'rewind' option in Swiper or Flickity) so that swiping past the last slide shows the first. Expose theme settings for dot shape (circle / square) and for the colors of the three states: active (filled), inactive (filled), inactive (outline only). Render the dots with CSS variables driven by those settings. The source does not describe the base gallery or its implementation, so the details are an inference.

dependencies.text: Requires an existing swipeable product image gallery with pagination dots (the 'version 1.0' this ticket extends). The slider library must support looping. No metafields or apps are mentioned.
